    Chester to Host Christmas Crafting Sessions

    • Nov, 2026
    • Visit Chester - Arts Heritage & Culture in Chester
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 1:20
    Instaread

    Storyhouse in Chester is holding two opportunities to get hands-on and make decorations for Christmas this year. The specially designed arts and crafts events will take place in the celebrated arts centre’s Garret Bar in November and December and invite residents and visitors in the city to get involved.

    On Sunday, November 29, the first session is titled “Christmas Wreath Making”. Those taking part will get a chance to make a yuletide wreath to decorate their front door under expert supervision. The second event will run the following month on Sunday, December 12 and is called “Christmas Centrepiece Making”. Offering a hands-on experience, it lets crafters create a table decoration to take home and style up their festive feasts.

    Both sessions are suited to individuals of all experience levels, from total novices to those experienced in arts and crafts. A professional florist will lead both activities and offer step-by-step guidance to help participants make the best festive decorations possible.

    On arrival at the events, guests will be greeted with a welcoming Christmas cocktail. Tickets to take part in each session cost £45 per person for Storyhouse members and £50 for non-members. Both ticket types are subject to a booking fee of £1.50. The admission price includes the cost of all materials and tools necessary to craft the wreaths or centrepieces.

    The sessions are two hours long and start at 11 am. The Garret theatre bar can be found within Storyhouse on Hunter Street in Chester.
